correctness.rationale: For every integer m,n>=3, the source Green function is constructed edgewise by solving -g"=delta_x-ds/(mn). Explicit vertex potentials solve every Kirchhoff equation; the mean-zero shift follows by exact edge integration; the diagonal reduces to an explicit strict concave quadratic. Its vertex exclusion, unique interior maximum on every one of mn edges, exact completed-square deficit, symmetries, and asymptotic limits follow algebraically. Riesz equality gives every extremizer. A symbolic all-parameter algebra checker and 87 independent exact-rational subdivided-graph Green/energy checks passed; these finite checks are not the universal proof.

value.rationale: This solves the sharp H1-to-C norm and all equality locations for the natural entire equilateral complete-bipartite metric-graph family with m,n>=3. Strict interior localization differs from naive vertex-based expectations; degree imbalance causes an exact displacement, and the completed square is a quantitative stability statement. The fixed-side and jointly increasing connectivity limits distinguish structurally different regimes, beyond a small isolated computation.
